name: Solving puzzles and planning problems
gist: Combinatorial puzzles—routing, scheduling, assignment—are computationally hard. Can learning and neural methods find good solutions faster than traditional algorithms?
explain: Imagine you run a delivery company and need to find the shortest route visiting 100 stops. Or you schedule hospital staff shifts so everyone gets fair hours. Or you assign students to dorm rooms so everyone is happy. These are combinatorial optimization problems—problems where the answer is a discrete choice (this route, not that one; this person in this dorm, not that building). The challenge is that the number of possibilities explodes: with 100 stops, there are more routes than atoms in the universe. No computer can check them all.

Classical algorithms (like branch-and-bound or dynamic programming) can find good answers by being clever—they prune impossible branches, use symmetry, and solve subproblems first. But they are slow on hard problems. Modern neural networks are fast at making decisions, but they have no guarantee their answer is actually good. The research question is: can you train a neural network to learn heuristics that beat classical methods, or can you combine neural prediction with classical search to get speed and quality both?

Papers use several approaches. Some train a neural network to predict which stops to visit next in a traveling-salesman-style problem, then use classical branch-and-bound to refine its guess. Others treat the problem as a graph and use message-passing networks to learn patterns in the graph structure—if you see this shape, this assignment usually works. Some papers learn to warm-start a solver: instead of beginning from scratch, the neural network guesses a decent starting point that is already pretty good, and the solver improves it faster than it would from a random start, which saves computation because fewer refinement steps are needed. A few use reinforcement learning, where the network makes choices one-at-a-time and gets rewarded for finding short routes. The common thread is: combine the speed of neural prediction with the reliability of classical methods.

papers.title: BoGrape: Bayesian optimization over graphs with shortest-path encoded
papers.contribution: Competitive performance on general synthetic benchmarks and representative molecular design case studies with application-specific constraints.

papers.title: Dynamic Stratified Contrastive Learning with Upstream Augmentation for MILP Branching
papers.contribution: Significantly improves branching accuracy and reduces solving time with particularly strong gains at upstream nodes, scaling to large-scale instances.

papers.title: HONet: Data-Efficient Learning for Exact Cover Tasks via Hypergraph Optimization
papers.contribution: Rapidly achieves 100% accuracy on 9x9 Sudoku using limited samples with superior data efficiency, robustness in sparse regimes, and scalability to additional tasks.

papers.title: LoRe: Adaptive Interaction-Evaluation Routing with Per-step Interaction Budgets for Iterative Graph Solvers
papers.contribution: LoRe extends feasible MIS inference 3x beyond baseline's out-of-memory limit with ~8x speedup and ~12x memory reduction while preserving solution quality; achieves ~15x speedup on TSP with 44x memory reduction.

papers.title: Optimal Design for Multinomial Logit Model with Applications to Best Assortment Identification
papers.contribution: Establishes near G-optimality guarantees and instance-dependent sample complexity of O(d log N / Delta^2) for best assortment identification.

papers.title: Optimal Transport–Guided Stochastic Control for Graph Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: Demonstrates improved solution quality and efficiency over strong combinatorial and learning-based baselines on graph combinatorial optimization.

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Benchmarking of Reinforcement Learning Algorithms for Large-Scale Flow Control
papers.contribution: FluidGym enables systematic comparison of control methods and establishes a scalable foundation for learning-based flow control research.

papers.title: Preference-Modulated Structural Attention for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: The approach achieves superior performance and generalization on classic MOCOP benchmarks by synergizing node and edge features for preference-aware structure perception.

papers.title: RAPNet: Accelerating Algebraic Multigrid with Learned Sparse Corrections
papers.contribution: RAPNet outperforms classical non-Galerkin baselines on diverse PDE discretizations and graph Laplacians, particularly effective for multi-query tasks.

papers.title: ViTSP: A Vision Language Models Guided Framework for Large-Scale Traveling Salesman Problems
papers.contribution: Achieves sub-0.2% average optimality gaps on instances up to 88k nodes, surpassing LKH-3 by 12-100% gap reduction especially on very-large-scale instances.

papers.title: Vision-Zero: Scalable VLM Self-Improvement via Strategic Gamified Self-Play
papers.contribution: Introduces Iterative-SPO algorithm mitigating performance plateau in self-play-only training through alternating optimization.

papers.title: A General Neural Backbone for Mixed-Integer Linear Optimization via Dual Attention
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms GNN-based architectures across instance, element, and solving-state level tasks.

papers.title: A Scalable Constant-Factor Approximation Algorithm for $W_p$ Optimal Transport
papers.contribution: First quadratic-time method extending to W_∞ distance with significantly improved approximation factor over prior O(log n) results.

papers.title: Allocating Variance to Maximize Expectation
papers.contribution: Theoretical characterization of optimal variance allocation and efficient approximation algorithms with proven guarantees for the constrained Gaussian supremum maximization problem.

papers.title: An Approximation Algorithm for Graph Label Selection
papers.contribution: Provides first algorithm with provable guarantees and practical heuristic variants that scale to significantly larger graphs.

papers.title: Backward Oversmoothing: why is it hard to train deep Graph Neural Networks?
papers.contribution: The analysis reveals GNNs provably exhibit many spurious stationary points where gradients vanish while loss remains high, specific to GNNs not MLPs.

papers.title: Batched First-Order Methods for Parallel LP Solving in MIP
papers.contribution: Achieves significant computational advantages on GPU architectures for batched LP solving in strong branching and bound tightening with identified problem size sweet spots.

papers.title: Better Learning-Augmented Spanning Tree Algorithms via Metric Forest Completion
papers.contribution: Improves approximation factor from 2.62 to 2 for metric forest completion and from (2γ+1) to 2γ for metric MST, proven tight for worst-case instances.

papers.title: Branch and Bound Search for Exact MAP Inference in Credal Networks
papers.contribution: Provides exact algorithms for credal network MAP inference that scale to large and complex instances using effective heuristic guidance.

papers.title: Capacitated Fair-Range Clustering: Hardness and Approximation Algorithms
papers.contribution: The analysis shows inapproximability persists even when fair-range constraints are trivially satisfiable, while providing practical approximation algorithms with hardness-matched bounds.

papers.title: Chain-of-Context Learning: Dynamic Constraint Understanding for Multi-Task VRPs
papers.contribution: Achieves best performance on all in-distribution tasks and majority of out-of-distribution tasks across 48 VRP variants.

papers.title: Differentially Private Submodular Maximization with a Knapsack Constraint
papers.contribution: Achieves optimal approximation while significantly improving additive error and query complexity over prior work.

papers.title: Divide and Learn: Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization at Scale
papers.contribution: Achieves 80-98% of specialized solvers performance with two to three orders of magnitude improvement in sample and computational efficiency.

papers.title: Evolving Interdependent Operators with Large Language Models for Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: Evolution of Operator Combination framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art AHD and co-design methods with strong generalization across varying objectives and problem scales.

papers.title: From Sequential to Parallel: Reformulating Dynamic Programming as GPU Kernels for Large-Scale Stochastic Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: Processes over 10^6 uncertainty realizations in a single GPU pass, achieving one to three orders of magnitude speedups over multithreaded CPU baselines with nearly linear scaling.

papers.title: Generative Large Neighborhood Search: Scalable Set Cover Optimization via Discrete Diffusion
papers.contribution: GLNS achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art MIP solvers under equal wall-clock budgets and transfers effectively across cost regimes and instance scales.

papers.title: Implicit Bias of Per-sample Adam on Separable Data: Departure from the Full-batch Regime
papers.contribution: Prior analyses show that Adam favors solutions aligned with $\ell_\infty$-geometry, but these results are restricted to the full-batch regime

papers.title: InfoScan: Information-Efficient Visual Scanning via Resource-Adaptive Walks
papers.contribution: Achieves superior efficiency-accuracy trade-offs across diverse tasks via information-driven dynamic scanning.

papers.title: Instance-Specific Approximation Ratios for Correlation Clustering and Max-Cut
papers.contribution: Certifies that state-of-the-art heuristics achieve almost optimal approximation ratios of 0.94 for agreement and 1.97 for disagreement version on correlation clustering averaged over 7 real-world datasets.

papers.title: Learning Randomized Reductions
papers.contribution: Vanilla Bitween discovers RSRs for 54% of 80 functions; Agentic Bitween discovers 80%, including first known reduction for sigmoid.

papers.title: Learning to Approximate Uniform Facility Location via Graph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Has provable approximation guarantees and empirically improves on standard approximation algorithms.

papers.title: Learning to Bet for Horizon-Aware Anytime-Valid Testing
papers.contribution: Learned DQN policies yield state-of-the-art results on limited-horizon experiments by identifying regions where Kelly, fractional Kelly, and aggressive betting are optimal.

papers.title: Learning-Augmented Online Covering Problems
papers.contribution: A universal framework applicable to facility location, Steiner problems, set cover, and parking permits that breaks worst-case lower bounds with accurate predictions and gracefully degrades with error.

papers.title: Learning-Augmented Scalable Linear Assignment Problem Optimization via Neural Dual Warm-Starts
papers.contribution: Robust zero-shot generalization with strict optimality; end-to-end speedups of over 2x on complex synthetic data, 1.25x on real-world tracking, 1.5x on transportation networks.

papers.title: Learning-augmented Rent-or-Buy with a Sample
papers.contribution: Even sparse samples significantly improve competitive ratio, with theoretical bounds verified via numerical simulations across natural input classes.

papers.title: Lifelong Learning with Behavior Consolidation for Vehicle Routing
papers.contribution: Demonstrates effectiveness in lifelong learning for vehicle routing while maintaining performance on previous tasks and improving zero-shot generalization.

papers.title: Local Minima in Quadratic-Penalty Relaxations of Binary Linear Programs
papers.contribution: Gradient-based methods can safely solve common combinatorial problems like open-pit mining, knapsack, and traveling salesman by ensuring every local minimizer is both binary and feasible.

papers.title: MILPnet: A Multi-Scale Architecture with Geometric Feature Sequence Representations for Advancing MILP Problems
papers.contribution: Outperforms graph-based methods by multiple orders of magnitude on Foldable MILPs in feasibility prediction and convergence speed, with strong performance on real-world benchmarks.

papers.title: MaskCO: Masked Generation Drives Effective Representation Learning and Exploiting for Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: MaskCO turns single (instance, solution) pairs into hundreds of training examples and enables local-search-like refinement during inference.

papers.title: MuLoCo: Muon is a Practical Inner Optimizer for DiLoCo
papers.contribution: At $K=1$, we find that MuLoCo can even outperform the data-parallel gold standard while having larger critical batch sizes and faster training times as a result

papers.title: Neural Multi-Objective Combinatorial Optimization for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problems
papers.contribution: Outperforms traditional multi-objective optimization methods and generalizes well across diverse problem instances, enabling multi-criteria scheduling via neural methods.

papers.title: Neural QAOA$^2$: Differentiable Joint Graph Partitioning and Parameter Initialization for Quantum Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: The gradient-driven approach outperforms heuristic baselines on 183 QUBO, Ising, and MaxCut instances, ranking first on 101 instances with zero-shot generalization across topologies.

papers.title: Parsimonious Learning-Augmented Online Metric Matching
papers.contribution: Establishes theoretical lower bounds on performance for parsimonious learning-augmented metric matching and demonstrates practical effectiveness through empirical evaluation.

papers.title: PoMtVRS: Preference-Optimized Multi-Task Vehicle Routing Solver with Preference Gating
papers.contribution: Elevates state-of-the-art unified neural VRP backbones with leading performance on multi-task benchmarks and stronger generalization.

papers.title: RESCHED: Rethinking Flexible Job Shop Scheduling from a Transformer-based Architecture with Simplified States
papers.contribution: Outperforms classical dispatching rules and state-of-the-art DRL methods on FJSP while generalizing well to JSSP and FFSP variants.

papers.title: RL-SPH: Learning to Achieve Feasible Solutions for Integer Linear Programs
papers.contribution: Rapidly obtains high-quality feasible solutions with 100% feasibility rate; achieves 28.6× lower primal gap and 2.6× lower primal integral than existing start primal heuristics.

papers.title: RL4RLA: Teaching ML to Discover Randomized Linear Algebra Algorithms Through Curriculum Design and Graph-Based Search
papers.contribution: Rediscovers state-of-the-art methods (sketch-and-precondition, Randomized Kaczmarz, Newton Sketch) optimized for accuracy/speed/stability trade-offs.

papers.title: Simple Algorithms for Bad Triangle Transversals with Applications to Correlation Clustering
papers.contribution: Establish that BTT is NP-hard to approximate better than 2137/2136 and show BTT optima are within a factor of 3/2 of correlation clustering optima in complete graphs.

papers.title: StepORLM: A Self-Evolving Framework With Generative Process Supervision For Operations Research Language Models
papers.contribution: Establishes state-of-the-art on six OR benchmarks outperforming larger models; GenPRM acts as universal process verifier boosting inference scaling.

papers.title: TSP with Predictions: Heatmap to Tour with Provable Guarantees
papers.contribution: The approach provides (1+2η/OPT)-approximation guarantees where η is the L1 distance between prediction and optimal tour.

papers.title: Theoretical Challenges in Learning for Branch-and-Cut
papers.contribution: Shows arbitrarily small perturbations and score discrepancies can produce exponentially different tree sizes, motivating data-driven methods better aligned with global objectives.

papers.title: Towards Optimal Robustness in Learning-Augmented Paging
papers.contribution: Achieve the best-possible robustness of H_k + O(1) competitive ratio for learning-augmented paging with strong practical performance demonstrated experimentally.

papers.title: Towards Real-World Routing with Neural Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on a new real-world VRP benchmark featuring asymmetric distance and duration matrices from 100 diverse cities.

papers.title: Transport Clustering: Solving Low-Rank Optimal Transport via Clustering
papers.contribution: Polynomial-time approximation algorithms achieving (1+γ) approximation for negative-type metrics, (1+γ+√(2γ)) for kernel costs, and (1+γ+ρ) for general metrics.

papers.title: URS: A Unified Neural Routing Solver for Cross-Problem Zero-Shot Generalization
papers.contribution: First neural solver handling 110 VRP variants (99 unseen) with single model, achieving high-quality solutions and scaling to 7000-node instances.

papers.title: Unsat Core Prediction through Polarity-Aware Representation Learning over Clause-Literal Hypergraphs
papers.contribution: Improves unsat-core prediction through explicit modeling of polarity properties and higher-order structural interactions on multiple SAT datasets.

papers.title: Unsupervised Diffusion Solver for Combinatorial Optimization via Combinatorial Adjoint Matching
papers.contribution: Unsupervised training achieves performance competitive with supervised diffusion solvers and traditional solvers on diverse combinatorial problems.
